sources.title: State House of the Republic of The Gambia

capital.evidence_quote: Banjul is the island capital, maritime port, and seat of government of The Gambia

currency.evidence_quote: The Gambian Dalasi (GMD, D) is the legal tender currency governed by the Central Bank of The Gambia

sources.title: Ministry of Transport, Works & Infrastructure Gambia

timezone.evidence_quote: The Gambia strictly maintains Greenwich Mean Time (UTC+0) year-round without seasonal clock alteration

sources.title: NAWEC National Water and Electricity Company

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase domestic electrical supply across The Gambia is nominal 230V at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National grid operating frequency is maintained at 50 Hz alternating current

plug_types.evidence_quote: British standard rectangular three-pin Type G sockets are universal across The Gambia

police.evidence_quote: Dial 117 nationwide for Gambia Police Force emergency intervention and traffic control

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 116 nationwide for public emergency medical ambulance assistance

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 118 for Gambia Fire and Rescue Service emergency fire squads and rescue units

general.evidence_quote: Dial 112 from any mobile device for national emergency services coordination

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Security Unit (TSU) operates dedicated foot and beach patrols reached via 117 or local tourism offices

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Standart Önlemler ('Afrika'nın Gülen Kıyısı', Son Derece Huzurlu ve Dostane)
advisory_headline.en: Exercise Normal Precautions ('The Smiling Coast of Africa', Peaceful & Hospitable)
advisory_headline.de: Normale Vorsicht ('The Smiling Coast of Africa', friedlich und gastfreundlich)
advisory_headline.ru: Стандартные меры предосторожности («Улыбающийся берег Африки», мирно и гостеприимно)
advisory_headline.es: Precauciones normales ('La Costa Sonriente de África', pacífica y hospitalaria)

regional_warnings.reason: Unlicensed beach hustlers (bumsters); firm and polite refusal is recommended

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: The Gambia delivers median mobile download speeds around 17.5 Mbps on Africell and QCell 4G

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Fixed broadband median download speeds in Banjul and Serrekunda average 18.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: SIM registration mandatory with passport ID via Africell or QCell; QMoney and Afrimoney are popular mobile payment solutions
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: PURA telecommunications directives mandate valid biometric passport presentation for all SIM activations

religion.value: Islam (~96% Sunni majority), Christianity (~4%), traditional customs
religion.evidence_quote: National statistics document over 95 percent Muslim population coexisting in deep religious tolerance with Christians

festivals.value: Roots Homecoming Festival, Banjul Cultural Carnival, Janjanbureh Kankurang Festival, Eid al-Fitr (Koriteh), Tobaski
festivals.evidence_quote: Kankurang masked tradition inscribed by UNESCO, central to initiation and seasonal community festivities

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Modest clothing recommended in inland towns and villages; swimwear acceptable only on hotel beachfronts and pools; respect community elders and religious norms; all narcotics possession strictly penalized with mandatory prison terms
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Dress modestly outside coastal beach complexes; zero-tolerance narcotics legislation rigorously enforced

tipping.value: Customary in tourism; 10% in hotel restaurants and bars; tipping river pirogue boatmen, birdwatching guides, and hotel staff is standard courtesy
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is customary across tourist resorts, safari lodges, and nature guiding services
